children.text: How to Order Your Maryland Cannabis Delivery

children.html:
1. Browse the Online Menu: Visit our website to view our real-time inventory and current specials. Our menu is updated constantly to reflect our latest arrivals.
  2. Age Verification: State regulations require us to verify your age. You will be prompted to provide a photo of your ID during the secure checkout process.
  3. Discreet Logistics: Our professional drivers use unmarked vehicles to ensure your privacy within your neighborhood. We prioritize safety and promptness for every route.
  4. Residential Delivery: We deliver exclusively to private residential addresses. Please have your physical ID ready for a final check when your driver arrives.

We are proud to offer dependable delivery to a wide range of locations. No matter where you are located, we bring the premium dispensary experience to your private residence. Our primary service areas include:

  • Montgomery County: Bethesda, Potomac, Rockville, Silver Spring, and Germantown.
  • Prince George’s County: Bowie, Hyattsville, Laurel, South Laurel, and Forest Heights.
  • Howard & Anne Arundel Counties: Columbia and Hanover.
  • Southern Maryland: Waldorf and Lusby.
  • Northern & Central Maryland: Baltimore and Frederick.

items.q: Is weed delivery legal in Maryland?

blocks.html: Yes. Since Maryland legalized adult-use cannabis, licensed delivery services can legally bring cannabis products to adults 21 and older at their private residences.

items.q: How long does delivery usually take?

blocks.html: While delivery times vary based on your specific location and local traffic conditions, we strive for rapid fulfillment. Most orders are delivered within a 60 to 90-minute window.

items.q: What do I need to show the driver?

blocks.html: You must present a valid government-issued photo ID (such as a driver’s license or passport) to prove you are 21 or older at the time of delivery.
Yes. Per Maryland law, individuals may purchase up to 1.5 ounces of flower, 12 grams of concentrated cannabis, or products containing up to 750mg of THC per transaction.
